تراشقت (form VI)
# تَرَاشَقْتُ (tarāšaqtu) /ta.raː.ʃaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تَرَاشَقْتَ (tarāšaqta) /ta.raː.ʃaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تَرَاشَقْتِ (tarāšaqti) /ta.raː.ʃaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تَرَاشَقَتْ (tarāšaqat) /ta.raː.ʃa.qat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
